mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

No decision on the transport compression codec is currently recorded for this project, so no codec is specified here. This document will be updated once a decision is made and recorded.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says that no decision on the transport compression codec is currently recorded, so it names no codec and mentions no alternatives.

I based that on the project's decision catalog. It lists four entries: https everywhere, verification on all builds, rustls, and an LRU cache with a 300-second TTL. None of them is about compression.

The Muninn memory hooks also reported a warning that 20 hook runs started and never finished. The log is at `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`, in case that needs a look.
